Noah (PartnerEng): quick sync request from QDRant marketplace team: they want a documented connector failover choreography and a preflight checklist before listing. can we assemble?
Ivy (Runtime Eng): what scope? failover between our hosted runtime and customer-managed vector nodes, or just cross-region?
Noah (PartnerEng): both. they want clear behavior when vector DBs are unreachable: retry windows, fallback to degraded embedding cache mode, and marketplace-facing status flags.
Samir (Product): propose modes: normal -> degraded-cache -> read-only -> offline. each with precise toggles and UI labels.
Lucy (Field): customers will want deterministic read-only for critical queries. also need a migration path for reconciling queued writes after restore.
Ivy (Runtime Eng): technical plan: implement health probes to vector endpoints, circuit-breaker (5 failures -> degrade), short-term local cache (TTL 30m), and write-queue durable in S3 for hosted. on restore, we'll reconcile with idempotent writes.
Chris (Legal): for marketplace listing, require clear liability language around message queueing and data retention for reconcile. also add an opt-in for storing queued items for private deployments.
Noah (PartnerEng): marketplace asks for a one-page preflight: required env vars, network ports, DNS resolution check, and a small smoke test script. can someone draft?
Ivy (Runtime Eng): I'll add a smoke test: `curl -sS /v1/health && curl -sS /v1/ping-vec` plus a sample embed-write/read verification. will include exit codes.
Samir (Product): include header X-Connector-State in responses for the marketplace UI. states must map to our mode enum.
Lucy (Field): add support playbook: how to force failover, how to drain write-queue, and emergency contact for partner ops. 48hr SLAs for reconciling queued writes in hosted mode.
Chris (Legal): i'll draft the limited liability stanza and the opt-in language for queued data retention.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: "QDRant marketplace preflight review" scheduled 2025-07-21 15:00 UTC
Noah (PartnerEng): action items: Ivy -> smoke test + circuit-breaker PR; Samir -> header mapping + UI copy; Lucy -> playbook + SLA bullets; Chris -> legal addendum; Noah -> assemble one-pager and share with QDRant before review. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
